seeds.context: Defi Snacks sells six premium crispy superfood snack bites, including dark and milk chocolate varieties with flavors like pink Himalayan salt and peanut butter crunch. Prices range from $59.91 to $111.80, with family‑size variety packs and a build‑your‑own option. The products are marketed to health‑conscious snackers and families seeking indulgent yet nutrient‑dense treats. All products contain milk, and some contain peanuts.
questions: Which ad hooks, formats, and angles are currently performing best across top consumer brands in any industry, and how could Defi Snacks adapt those creative strategies to its superfood chocolate snack line and brand voice?

What audience targeting and messaging tactics are most effective for premium health‑focused snack brands, and how can Defi Snacks differentiate its ads while appealing to families and wellness‑oriented consumers?
